title: Sweet Cream
description: An old-style classic that never disappoints! Made from the simplest ingredients-- milk, cream, sugar, eggs. Bonus: perfect with any topping!

title: Milk Chocolate
description: Creamy, sweet-- the perfect nostalgic chocolate ice cream.

title: Birthday Cake
description: Just like your favorite funfetti birthday cake...in ice cream form!

title: Mint Oreo
description: Our cool peppermint ice cream is riddled with Oreo cookie pieces (no pesky green dye included).

title: Salted Butterscotch Toffee
description: Salty butterscotch ice cream riddled with Heath toffee bits!

title: Rum Raisin
description: Perfectly nostalgic and classic! With notes of caramel and rum, and riddled with plump rum-soaked raisins throughout.

title: Blueberry Goat’s Cheese
description: An OG favorite at Leones' Creamery. Bursting with sweet blueberries and a lil' bit of goat cheese funk. It's creamy, sweet, tangy, and perfect.

title: Vegan Banana Creme
description: Made from coconut milk and vegan! We churn this ice cream up with plenty of fresh bananas, coconut milk, and turbinado sugar. Bananas Foster inspired!
